### Falling Short of Our Promises - One Year Devotions for Women
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/falling-short-of-our-promises-one-year-devotions-for-women-february-28.html
Passage: Nehemiah 10:39
Points:
- The people of Israel pledged never to neglect God's house or the Levites who ministered there.
- During Nehemiah's absence, the people failed their commitment, forcing temple workers to abandon ministry to farm for food.
- Believers carry a vital duty to support the house of worship and those called to full-time spiritual service.
- God calls believers in secular employment to provide materially for those who feed them spiritually.
- Church members must back up their spoken commitments with faithful giving rather than falling short on promises.

### PowerPoint - Oct. 9, 2007
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-oct-9-2007-1434554.html
Passage: Nehemiah 10:39
Points:
- The Christian journey consists of constant growth, fresh dedication, and new beginnings.
- Believers face the peril of spiritual plateaus, where past success leads to complacency and stagnation.
- After completing the city wall, the Israelites intentionally recommitted their lives and vowed not to neglect God's house.
- Believers should reject spiritual laziness and actively seek God's next step of service and growth.
